description: Java class TextureRenderer for rendering textures with OpenGL ES 2.0 in Android, including shader setup, buffer initialization, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TextureRenderer
classes.description: Handles OpenGL ES texture rendering, shader compilation, buffer setup, and drawing operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes shader program and coordinate buffers.

methods.name: updateTextureSize
methods.description: Updates texture dimensions and recomputes vertices.

methods.name: updateViewSize
methods.description: Updates view dimensions and recomputes vertices.

methods.name: renderTexture
methods.description: Binds texture and renders it using OpenGL.

methods.name: computeOutputVertices
methods.description: Calculates vertices to maintain aspect ratio based on texture and view sizes.
